title: Google’s biggest clean power project is 40 miles north of xAI’s unpermitted gas power plant
slides: What if Google's clean power fuels Musk's dirty one?
Google just announced its largest clean energy project ever.
It sits 40 miles from xAI's unpermitted gas plant.
Your AI queries may soon run on a bizarre hybrid grid.
Check if your data center uses this mixed power source.
thread_text:
1. A gas plant for AI

Google’s clean energy project is 40 miles from xAI’s unpermitted gas plant.

2. Why that distance matters

Your AI queries may run on a hybrid grid mixing green power and fossil fuel backup.

3. The irony in the pipeline

Google powers clean tech; xAI runs on dirty gas. Both feed the same AI queries.

4. What the grid hides

Data centers don't label their source. You can't tell if your prompt fuels methane.

5. Check your data center today

Ask your provider: what percentage of my AI compute comes from gas backup?
